name: Quick Cable Corporation
old_description: QuickCable® is a leading U.S.-based manufacturer of battery connection solutions, proudly delivering American-made quality and innovation for more than 80 years. From battery to application, we connect it all™ through a broad portfolio of terminal connectors, cable assemblies, tools, and custom-engineered power solutions designed for demanding commercial vehicle, industrial, agricultural, construction, military/defense, material handling, marine, and specialty applications. Backed by deep engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and the QuickEverything™ commitment to comprehensive power connectivity solutions, QuickCable helps customers improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency in mission-critical environments.
about:
Quick Cable Corporation, operating as QuickCable®, is headquartered in Franksville, Wisconsin, with a second manufacturing and distribution site in Mississauga, Ontario. The company was founded in 1946 by Jack Shannon and has grown from a specialty battery maker into a manufacturer of battery connection solutions for commercial and industrial markets.

QuickCable engineers and manufactures a broad portfolio of terminal connectors, cable assemblies, tools, and custom-engineered power solutions. Its in-house capabilities include die-casting, stamping, machining, cable assembly, plastic molding, printing, non-ferrous metal casting, and wire and cable fabrication. The combined facilities support a workforce of approximately 150 employees and serve global distribution.

The company serves industries including material handling, standby power and generation, heavy-duty truck and bus, automotive, recreation, agriculture, electrical, powersports, commercial vehicles, construction, marine, and military/defense. Its customer base comprises OEMs, wire harness assemblers, distributors, dealers, and retailers seeking custom-designed connectors, cable assemblies, and battery accessories.

QuickCable states its mission is to drive customer success through leadership and innovation in the energy storage industry, emphasizing American-made quality and a product offering described as the broadest and most comprehensive in the industry. The company highlights its QuickEverything™ commitment to comprehensive power connectivity solutions and value-added distribution services as key differentiators.
